readout_other: multi-unit activity classified as putative excitatory and inhibitory neurons; LFP theta power; thermocouple brain temperature
direction_notes: Low intensity AM-tFUS reduced firing of putative inhibitory interneurons and theta power; intermediate intensity had no effect; high intensity increased firing of putative excitatory neurons and theta power.
safety_notes: Brain temperature rise at the target limited to about 0.2 C at the highest intensity (thermocouple, n=8).

exposures.label: AM-tFUS to right hippocampus (low, intermediate, high intensity)

timing.protocol_description: Continuous 2.0 MHz carrier amplitude modulated at 40 Hz (100% AM depth), three-minute sonications, recorded two minutes before and five minutes after; low, intermediate and high intensity delivered in fixed order with 20 min to 1 h between; sham before active at each intensity.
